description: Computes verified top-k Principal Component Analysis (PCA) / Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) on distributed GPU workers via randomized subspace iteration or stateful power iteration.

k.description: Number of top singular/principal components to extract.

matrix.description: File path (.npy/.npz/.safetensors) or inline 2D array of shape (M, N).

output_path.description: Optional output file path (.npz or .safetensors) to save U, S, Vt.

name: compute_pca_svd
